notice: These rules are narrow issue-spotting prompts, not legal conclusions. Applicability and current law must be confirmed against the actual facts and authoritative materials by a qualified Indian lawyer.

rules.message: A restraint-of-trade or non-compete term was detected. Review its scope, timing, parties, and facts; this flag is not an enforceability decision.

rules.law: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006
rules.message: The payment term may need review against MSMED delayed-payment provisions if the supplier is an eligible micro or small enterprise. Confirm eligibility, acceptance date, and applicable current provisions before drawing a conclusion.
rules.source_title: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006

rules.law: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and applicable Rules
rules.provision: Review processing roles, purposes, notices, safeguards, and processor terms where relevant
rules.message: Personal-data or data-processing language was detected. Review the parties' roles and the current applicable Act and Rules; this text match is not a compliance determination.
rules.source_title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023; Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025

rules.provision: Review arbitration agreement and procedure in context
rules.message: An arbitration term was detected. Consider having the arbitration process, seat, venue, and appointment language reviewed for clarity; this is not a validity decision.

rules.law: Information Technology Act, 2000 and applicable rules
rules.provision: Review electronic records, electronic signatures, execution method, and any relevant exclusions in context
rules.message: Electronic-record or signature language was detected. Review the chosen execution method and applicable statutory requirements and exclusions; the prototype does not determine whether an electronic execution is valid.

rules.provision: Review copyright ownership, assignment, licence scope, and applicable requirements in context
rules.message: Copyright or copyright-licensing language was detected. Review the works, rights, scope, duration, territory, consideration, and applicable statutory requirements; no ownership or validity conclusion is made.

rules.law: Applicable central and state/UT employment legislation
rules.provision: Identify applicable legislation, commencement/notifications, rules, and party/worker coverage from the facts
rules.message: Employment, wage, worker, or workplace language was detected. Identify the applicable central and state/UT legislation, current commencement and rules, and coverage based on the parties and facts. This prototype does not determine employment status or compliance.
rules.source_title: Ministry of Labour & Employment — Labour Codes (official index)

rules.law: Applicable public procurement terms, manuals, solicitation, and GeM conditions where relevant
rules.provision: Check the current tender/solicitation and applicable General, Special, and Additional Terms and Conditions
rules.message: Public-procurement, tender, or GeM language was detected. Review the current solicitation and all applicable procurement terms and conditions; the prototype does not determine procurement compliance or which term prevails.
rules.source_title: Government e Marketplace — Terms and Conditions; Department of Expenditure — Procurement Manual (2022)

rules.law: Applicable State stamp law and current schedule
rules.provision: Verify state-specific instrument classification and duty; no calculation is supported
rules.message: Stamp-duty treatment may depend on the instrument and state facts. Verify the current state law and schedule; no stamp-duty amount or registration requirement is calculated by this prototype.
